root.label: California Democratic lawmakers demand Trump apology for Iran rally remarks

events.label: California Democratic lawmakers demand Trump apology for Iran rally remarks

slots.name: cities mentioned
slots.sentence: California Democratic lawmakers on Tuesday demanded President Trump apologize for remarks he made at a campaign rally suggesting Iran could “take out” Los Angeles and San Diego.

slots.name: affected population
slots.sentence: “As members of the California Democratic Congressional Delegation, we call on President Trump to apologize to the over 16 million Americans who live in the Los Angeles and San Diego metropolitan areas and all Americans who expect more out of our President,” the delegation, chaired by Rep. Zoe Lofgren (D-Calif.), said in a joint statement.

slots.name: number of members
slots.sentence: Lofgren was joined by the state’s 40 House members and Sens. Adam Schiff (D-Calif.) and Alex Padilla (D-Calif.) in responding to Trump’s comment earlier this week in Grand Island, Neb.
